description: Asks when a malformed pattern is diagnosed relative to matching: q[, xq[, q*[ and q*[C-A] with LIKE, and q%[ and q%[C-A] with ALIKE, against x, qx, q, empty, yq, xqx and qabc (Pat group p04), each pattern its own projection. Then constant-folded forms 'x' LIKE 'q[', 'q' LIKE 'q[' and '' LIKE 'q[' as their own SELECTs. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
